{"id":1514297716,"question_id":2685,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1737355503,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1514297716/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"First Completely Painted Row or Column","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\n    #define pairing pair<int ,int>\npublic:\n    int firstCompleteIndex(vector<int>& arr, vector<vector<int>>& mat) {\n        int n = mat.size();\n        int m = mat[0].size();\n\n        vector<pairing>lookup(m*n + 1);\n        for(int i=0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j =0 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                lookup[mat[i][j]] = make_pair(i,j);          \n            }\n        }\n        vector<int>row_counter(n,0);\n        vector<int>col_counter(m,0);\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<m*n ; i++)\n        {\n            pairing coordinate = lookup[arr[i]];\n            int x = coordinate.second;\n            int y = coordinate.first;\n\n            row_counter[x]++;\n            col_counter[y]++;\n\n            if(row_counter[x] == n || col_counter[y] == m)\n            return i;\n        }\n    return 0;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"first-completely-painted-row-or-column","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":206}
